April 8, 2018 - By Ellis Scott 
Eric Bannasch decreased its stake in Facebook Inc (FB) by 23.46% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Cadian Capital Management Lp sold 87,032 shares as the company’s stock declined 14.10% with the market. The hedge fund run by Eric Bannasch held 283,968 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $50.11M, down from 371,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Cadian Capital Management Lp who had been investing in Facebook Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $456.67 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.34% or $2.14   $157.2. About 41.64M shares traded or 20.08% up from the average. Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) has risen 8.48%   uptrending. It has underperformed by 3.07% the S&P500. 
Sfe Investment Counsel increased its stake in Fedex Corp (FDX) by 35.84% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Sfe Investment Counsel bought 2,618 shares as the company’s stock declined 6.15% with the market. The institutional investor held 9,922 shares of the air freight and delivery services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.48M, up from 7,304 at the end of the previous reported quarter. About 1.45 million shares traded. FedEx Corporation (NYSE:FDX) has risen 25.45%   uptrending. It has outperformed by 13.90% the S&P500. 
Analysts await Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) to report earnings on May, 2. They expect $1.40 earnings per share, up 34.62% or $0.36 from last year’s $1.04 per share. FB’s profit will be $4.07 billion for 28.07 P/E if the $1.40 EPS becomes a reality. After $2.20 actual earnings per share reported by Facebook, Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -36.36% negative EPS growth.
